newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial buys properties in N.J., N.Y..
newsitem.headline: First Industrial buys properties in N.J., N.Y..

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc. said Thursday it bought 39 properties in Long Island, N.Y., and New Jersey for $138.8 million.

Chicago-based First Industrial said the cash and stock purchase from Lazarus Burman, a closely held industrial real estate company on Long Island, would be a springboard for further expansion on the East Coast.
It said in a statement that as part of the deal it also obtained options to buy five more properties and 13.5 acres of land for potential development.

The properties total 2.7 million square feet and house a wide range of industrial tenants in Long Island's Nassau and Suffolk counties and Essex County in New Jersey. The properties are 96.7 percent occupied, it said.
First Industrial expects the initial return on investment to be about 11 percent.
